newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold no comment on German AVA buy talk.
newsitem.headline: Ahold no comment on German AVA buy talk.

text.p: Dutch supermarket group Ahold NV declined on Friday to comment on German rumours it could be interested in taking over German retailer AVA AG.
"As you know, it is our policy never to comment on market rumours," Ahold spokesman Hans Gobes said, adding Ahold was not interested in Germany and that had had not changed.
Ahold, which took over U.S. supermarkets chain Stop & Shop last year, and indicated earlier this month it intended to seek further expansion on the American east coast.
It also said it saw healthy growth possibilities in Asia, Latin America and Eastern Europe.
